channel.title: Business Insider France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider France (businessinsider.fr)

item.title: My son bought a $2 car and learned how to fix it himself. It gave him the independence he was craving.
item.description: My son bought a $2 car and rebuilt it himself. The independence he gained was worth far more than the car.

item.title: A 20-year-old woman had waves of stomach pain for months. She was eventually diagnosed with stage 2 colon cancer.
item.description: A 20-year-old woman experienced on-and-off stomach pain, then sudden nausea and chills. She was diagnosed with stage 2 colon cancer.

item.title: What to do if you're an American in the Middle East right now
item.description: Americans are being told to shelter in place in Middle Eastern countries including Iran, Qatar, and the UAE after the US and Israel struck Iranian cities including the capital, Tehran.

item.title: US military says stealth bombers, fighters, and 'special capabilities we can't list' went into the first 24 hours of Iran strikes
item.description: The US spent weeks establishing a massive military presence in the Middle East as Washington threatened Tehran with military action.

item.title: I'm stuck in Dubai after our flight was canceled. I'm paying more than $650 a night for a hotel.
item.description: We heard explosions from our hotel in Dubai, received emergency alerts, and watched our flight home get canceled.

item.title: Netflix says it bailed on WBD because of money, not Donald Trump
item.description: Netflix's rivals — Paramount owners Larry and David Ellison — had made a point of courting the President and other Republicans.

item.title: One of Amazon's data centers in the UAE caught fire after being hit by 'objects' amid the Middle East conflict
item.description: Amazon Web Services said on Sunday that connectivity from one of its UAE facilities went down after "objects" hit it and sparked a fire.

item.title: The best-dressed celebrities at the 2026 Actor Awards
item.description: "Reimagining Hollywood Glamour" was the event's dress code. Jenna Ortega, Kate Hudson, and Chase Infiniti all opted for warm neutrals.

item.title: War in the Middle East spills further open as Hezbollah and Israel trade strikes
item.description: Hezbollah said on Monday that it had launched missiles and drones into Israel to avenge the death of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, Iran's supreme leader.

item.title: Photos show chaos at airports as passengers are left stranded due to canceled flights
item.description: The heart of the chaos is in the Middle East, where airports in Dubai, Doha, and Abu Dhabi serve as megahubs for global connecting traffic.
